Today it +backtrader, with the cubicle exporter: the file carries its own Pine-exact indicators and the script's machine as the runner steps it, and its header names the script hash and the fill settings. A construct the target cannot express is refused and named (say which one, and that script_rehearse still runs the script). Today +cubicle.script, with the runner's own importer (cubicle-script import-pine). It answers the script (YAML, validated before -answers not_yet with +is handed out), the importer's notes (where Pine and the runner differ: fills, warm-up, na) and its header. entry.content: list_data_health: description +The AWS row carries `aws_coverage` and the GCP row `gcp_coverage` ({ total, readable, unreadable, excluded }) while multi-account / multi-project coverage is on. A GCP run that read BigQuery job usage adds `latest_run.usage_reconciliation` (jobs_bytes, export_bytes, difference_pct, outside_tolerance, worst_day) beside the warning text. list_usage_dimensions: description +Use "dimension_key" to list the keys of the pushed dimensions map; BigQuery job usage uses user_email (the user who ran the job), region, project_id, dts_config_id and query_hash. query_usage: description +GCP BigQuery job usage (gcp.bigquery.bytes_billed, gcp.bigquery.slot_ms) carries its who in the `user_email` dimension (also region, project_id, dts_config_id, query_hash): use breakdown_by "dimension:user_email". added get_gcp_usage_settings added get_sync_cadence added list_aws_member_accounts added list_gcp_projects

entry.content: check_medical_bill: inputSchema parameters: +When the bill covers more than one visit or claim there is usually one EOB per claim: send the rest in `eob_documents`. +input.eob_documents input.eob_documents description: More Explanation of Benefits files for the same bill, one per claim, each sent any of the three ways `eob_document` is. Added to `eob_document`, not instead of it; the same file twice is read once. Up to 4 in all. Each is read separately, so each adds to the time the check takes.
